rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that tastes of sugar.
This is the all-purpose noun for the sweet taste itself.

example.english: This coffee has a very noticeable sweet taste.
example.traditional: 呢杯咖啡有陣好明顯嘅甜味。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 jau5 zan6 hou2 ming4 hin2 ge3 tim4 mei6

rows.note: Use this for sugar-based candy or confectionery rather than the taste.

example.traditional: 細路仔最鍾意食呢粒糖。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ni1 lap1 tong4

rows.note: Use this for a dessert or the dessert course, especially on a menu.

example.english: Let’s order a sweet after dinner.
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 giu3 fan6 tim4 ban2 laa1

rows.note: Use this for music, a voice, or another sound that is pleasant to hear.

example.jyutping: nei1 sau2 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 teng1

rows.note: Use this for a person or appearance that is endearing or pleasing to look at, including when “sweet” means cute.

example.english: Your daughter looks sweet when she smiles.
example.traditional: 你個女笑起上嚟好可愛。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 neoi5 siu3 hei2 soeng6 lai4 hou2 ho2 oi3

rows.note: Use this for a pleasant or fragrant smell rather than a sugary taste.

example.english: This bouquet of flowers smells sweet.
example.jyutping: nei1 cuk1 faa1 man4 lok6 hou2 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this as a familiar term of affection for a sweetheart.

example.traditional: 寶貝，你今日做嘢辛苦喇。
example.jyutping: bou2 bui3 nei5 gam1 jat6 zou6 je5 san1 fu2 laa3
